title: Almost there, again
lines: The code almost works, the theory almost fits, and the chatbot suggests one more try.
One More Try explores the hope that keeps us returning to persuasive unfinished work.
Its imagined scenes follow a player, a programmer, and an aspiring researcher hoping for different kinds of success.

emotionalPlan.purpose: Recognize the difference between meaningful exploration and persuasive unfinished work.
emotionalPlan.visualActing: Show the nearly complete program with one unresolved condition rather than an endless spinning loop.

title: The shape of success
lines: An answer can look nearly right without showing whether it is getting any closer.
The book explores how curiosity, encouragement, and evidence shape the feeling of making progress.
It leaves room for the fun of exploring while asking why a conversation keeps renewing its promise.

Patient curiosity; gently emphasize “feeling of making progress”. Let the sentence land in an ordinary speaking voice, with no dramatic swell.
Gentle balance; gently emphasize “the fun of exploring”. Let the sentence land in an ordinary speaking voice, with no dramatic swell.
